relationships.rawText: The wiki Traits field explicitly includes Backpack; no separately named backpack was linked.
The B/FLAM-80 Cremator boasts increased fire damage and an ammunition backpack with 500 units of fuel.

As a backpack hose-fed weapon, it has the unique feature that it does not need to be manually reloaded like other backpack-reliant support weapons; however, it cannot be fired without its ammunition backpack equipped.
When the B/FLAM-80 Cremator and its Ammunition Backpack are initally picked up, a roughly 1-second animation will play where the Helldiver connects the fuel hose into the Support Weapon.
However, it requires its associated backpack tank to operate and has less fuel time overall than a fully resupplied FLAM-40.
Each full backpack contains enough fuel to fire for 62.35 seconds, and fuel is not consumed between lighting the pilot light and firing.
